tasks.title: Harden URL validation and SSRF/blocklist
tasks.description: Extend UrlValidator with scheme allowlist, credential rejection, loopback/private/link-local checks (IPv4/IPv6), DNS resolution with timeout, and config blocklist with subdomain match. Add input length limits.
tasks.validation: Unit tests show unsafe URLs return 400 and valid https returns 201

tasks.title: Create, metadata and expiry logic
tasks.description: Accept optional UTC expiry, reject past values with 400, store it, report expired flag in metadata, return 410 on expired redirect.
tasks.expectedOutput: Updated service, results, contracts and endpoints
tasks.validation: Expiry tests: future 302, past create 400, expired 410, metadata 200 with expired=true

tasks.title: Async click analytics
tasks.description: Bounded channel with configurable capacity, DropWrite, background processor, swallow sink errors; count only 302s; analytics endpoint 200/404.
tasks.validation: N redirects eventually yield N clicks; failing or slow sink does not change redirect status; 404/410/429 not counted

tasks.title: Per-endpoint per-IP rate limiting
tasks.description: Separate create and redirect policies keyed by client IP (trusted proxy opt-in), 429 with Retry-After, configurable, with stale-window eviction.
tasks.validation: Exceeding limits returns 429 with Retry-After; other clients unaffected; in-limit requests succeed

tasks.title: Tests for validation, create and expiry
tasks.description: Integration and unit tests for FR-1, FR-4 and FR-5 acceptance criteria, including legacy routes still working.
risks: DNS in test env; use a fake resolver
tasks.validation: dotnet test passes with all acceptance cases covered

tasks.title: Tests for redirect, analytics and rate limit, plus load check

tasks.expectedOutput: Tests and load-test script with results
